pf.license.need: from the state form: a youth camp license or permit for the camp's own grounds where the state's rules require one (a switch), renewed on the state's schedule; health inspections of the grounds, kitchen, water, cabins and swim area where the state's or county's rules require them (a switch); a backyard camp at a family's home may need none, or the host site's own OK (a switch)
pf.license.who: the business, for the camp license, its inspections and its registration; the camp nurse, for a nursing license; each counselor, for first aid and CPR certificates; waterfront staff, for their own water safety certificates
pf.license.ask: the camp license number and its end date where the state's form asks (shown in an obviously made-up example as EX-1042); the date of the last health inspection; the business registration; the camp nurse's license number; each person's first aid and CPR certificates; any accreditation the camp holds, only as the camp gives it
pf.license.check: none: Rosie never looks up, checks or confirms a license, insurance or registration (D96); anything shown is as given by the business, not checked by Rosie
pf.license.background: a background check for every staff member and regular volunteer before they start, and again on the state's schedule, where the state's rules require it (a switch from the state's form, on by default for anyone who works with children): who ran it and when, kept on file, shown to families only as the camp's own dated statement
pf.license.blocks: camp sessions go live only once the camp license is on file where the switch is on; a person is offered for camp work only once their background check (where on) and certificates are on file; a lapsed license takes the sessions offline until it's renewed, and Sam tells the families booked
pf.license.renewals: reminded 30 days and 7 days before the camp license, an inspection, a background check, a certificate or the insurance comes due
pf.license.insurance: liability insurance where the state's form asks for it, or where a host site (a school, a park, a community center) asks for proof
pf.license.accreditation: a voluntary accreditation shows only as the camp gives it, labeled voluntary, never as a license

pf.services.shape: class: a place in a set session (a day camp week or an overnight week) by age group, with a cap for each cabin or group and a free waitlist; each camper is one booking with their own check-in code, checked in at drop-off and handed back only to an approved adult at pick-up. A backyard camp week books two counselors for a group of children at the host family's home. A free camp tour books the director's time.
pf.services.examples: the example camps' own prices (Lee Lakeside Camp and Lee Backyard Camps), not a standard

pf.services.placement: by the camper's age on the first day of the session; overnight cabins by the grade finished in June and by gender; one cabin-mate request, kept where it fits
pf.services.capacity: 8 campers and 2 counselors a cabin; 10 campers and 2 counselors a day camp group; 6 children and 2 counselors at a backyard camp; a ratio from the state's form wins; each place is one camper with their own check-in code
pf.services.waitlist: a full session keeps a free waitlist in order; when a place opens, Sam OKs the offer to the next family, which has 48 hours to take it and pay the deposit (the camp's setting); no thanks takes the family off the list for that week; no reply in 48 hours passes the place to the next family and keeps the family on the list for a later opening
pf.services.minimum: none: a session runs with the campers it has
pf.services.siblings: each child is their own booking, in the session that fits their age; a sibling can be in another session the same week, with their own code and forms
pf.services.moves: free to another week of the same kind until May 1, while places are left; after that, Sam decides
pf.services.nobodyHome: never: at a backyard camp, an adult from the host family stays at the home the whole morning
pf.services.notOurs: the camp's daily schedule, cabin assignments beyond the booking, activities and staff hiring stay in the camp's own tools; Rosie finds, asks, registers, checks campers in and out, and takes payment

day camp or overnight, and which week

pf.safety.weather: lightning or a storm warning: campers go to the camp's shelter under its written emergency plan, and Sam sends families a short update with no child's name; a day the camp closes gets a make-up day or a refund for that day (the camp's setting)
pf.safety.children: a child is never alone with one adult out of sight of others; a child goes only to an adult on the pick-up list, with photo ID for anyone staff don't know; a missing child: the camp's emergency plan, 911, and the parent called right away; a sick or hurt child: first aid, 911 when it's serious, and the nurse or Sam calls the parent right away; any worry about a child's safety goes to Sam at once, and Sam reports it where the state's rules require
pf.safety.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency → call 911, and no booking

steps.name: The camp's agreement and risk notice
steps.when: signed on the secure page while registering
steps.who: a parent or guardian signs for the child
steps.result: signed: the booking goes on; not signed in 10 minutes: nothing is booked

steps.name: The pick-up list and the photo yes or no
steps.when: on the secure page while registering; the parent can change them until pick-up
steps.result: only adults on the list take the child home; no answer to photos counts as no

steps.name: Health form, shot record and medicine forms
steps.when: open when registering; due May 15 (the camp's setting; the state's rules can set more)
steps.who: the parent fills them; the camp nurse reads each one
steps.result: still missing: one reminder a week, then Sam calls; no camper checks in without them

steps.name: Backyard camp: each child's forms and the yard check
steps.when: each child's own parent fills that child's forms by 7 days before the first day; the host fills the yard check while booking
steps.result: the yard has a fence or a clear edge, shade, water and a bathroom inside; a pool is gated and locked; pets stay inside; a child with no forms doesn't join

pf.first_steps.prep: for the check-in note: the check-in window and the closing-day pick-up time; medicines in their original labeled boxes for the nurse; the camp's own packing list; photo ID for anyone picking up; for a backyard camp: the yard and the bathroom ready, pets inside, and each child's snack and water bottle

pf.visit.checkIn: overnight: on check-in day, the parent gives the camper's check-in code at the check-in table, the nurse takes any medicines and checks the forms, and the head counselor walks the camper to the cabin; day camp: each day the adult dropping off signs the camper in with the code, and signs out at pick-up; backyard camp: the code at the host's door on the first day, then each child signed in and out by their own adult each day; a camp tour: the code at the camp office
pf.visit.children: a child goes home only with an adult on the pick-up list; staff check photo ID for anyone they don't know; someone not on the list waits while the parent is called, and the child stays with staff; the parent can add a name on the secure page, and the ID is checked at pick-up
pf.visit.lateEntry: check-in is a window (2:00 to 4:00pm on Sundays); a family running late texts, and the camp waits until 6:00pm (the camp's setting)
pf.visit.changes: a cabin or counselor change inside the camp is the camp's own; a change of session or dates is texted to the parent with a yes first
pf.visit.done: the check-in code on the first day, the sign-out at closing-day pick-up, and the head counselor's DONE once every camper has gone home
pf.visit.note: health records and incident notes stay in the camp's own records on the secure page; a short end-of-week note may go to the parent by private link

pf.money.before: a camp session: a deposit when registering ($250 overnight, $400 two-week, $75 day camp), with the rest charged to the saved card when the session is done; or paid in full when registering, by choice; a camp tour: free, nothing taken; a backyard camp week: a $225 deposit when booking, with the rest charged to the saved card when the week is done; a school-holiday day camp, a backyard camp day and a birthday party: paid in full when booking
pf.money.installments: none through Rosie: the rest is charged once, when the session is done; a charge on a set day isn't offered (Rosie never charges the rest on a date by itself)
pf.money.caps: any limit on deposits or on money taken ahead for camp, and any bond or account kept apart: from the state's form
pf.money.cancel: the camp's own dated schedule, agreed on the secure page before paying: cancel by May 1, everything back but a $50 fee; May 2 to Jun 11, half the price back; after Jun 11, nothing back, unless Sam decides an exception. A backyard camp week: until 14 days before the first day, everything back but $50; then half, until 7 days before; then nothing, unless Sam decides. A school-holiday day camp or a party: free to cancel until 24 hours before (a party: 14 days); later, or a no-show, what's kept is Sam's call. A longer cancel right from the state's form wins. The tiers are each camp's own setting, shown on the secure page before paying: a camp can add one, like 'the deposit is kept' between two dates
pf.money.campCancels: the camp cancels a session or a day: a full refund of everything paid, or a free move, the family's choice; never a fee
pf.money.fees: no late-cancel or no-show fee on top: only the dated schedule applies; a refund the schedule gives in time goes out by itself, without Sam's OK; anything outside the schedule (a late cancel, a no-show, an exception) waits for Sam's yes by reply, with one reminder after 24 hours, and no answer means a full refund
pf.money.leaveEarly: a camper who goes home early (homesick, or sent home under the camp's rules): nothing back for days missed, unless Sam decides; a camper sent home sick or hurt: Sam decides a credit or a part refund
pf.money.tax: no tax line, unless the owner sets one
pf.money.fee2: pays Rosfield's $2 for each confirmed booking, counted at its first check-in: one $2 for each camper's session, however many days or weeks it covers; no visit, no $2
pf.money.unpaidRest: the rest declined at the end: one pay link, then Sam decides; Rosie never cancels a camper or charges again on its own

pf.messages.never: a child's last name, birth date, allergies, medicines, health needs, custody orders, the pick-up list (and who may not pick up) and photos never go in a text; texts to the parent may use the child's first name; texts to Sam or the staff carry none of it: they name the parent and the session, and link to the secure page
pf.messages.to: texts go to the parent who registered; another parent or guardian only once added on the secure page with their own yes
pf.messages.minors: a teen gets a link to send to a parent; Rosie never texts a child
pf.messages.photos: photos of a child are shared only with the parent's yes, and never by text
pf.messages.duringCamp: news about a sick or hurt child comes by a call from the nurse or Sam, never by text; group updates (a storm, a delay) name no child
pf.messages.pickUp: a same-day pick-up change by text is only a request: the text to the camp names the parent and the time, never the adult or the child; staff check the adult against the list on the secure page, with photo ID; a new adult is added only by the parent on the secure page, never from a text reply

pf.staff.checks: a background check on file for every staff member and regular volunteer before they start, where the state's rules require it (on by default); renewed on the state's schedule
pf.staff.ratio: 8 campers and 2 counselors a cabin; 10 campers and 2 counselors a day camp group; 6 children and 2 counselors at a backyard camp (the example camps' settings; a ratio from the state's form wins)
pf.staff.supervision: two adults with any group of children; counselors under 18 never count toward the ratio
pf.staff.whoOKs: Sam OKs waitlist offers, moves after May 1, refunds and exceptions; Pat may OK waitlist offers and moves too, and Sam's answer wins; Hannah, the camp nurse, answers health questions
